prerequisites: A solid background in secondary school algebra, geometry and trigonometry, as contained in Mathematics Precourse Program http://www.ing.univaq.it/noniscritti/precorsi.php

learning_outcomes.text: understand the basics of limit theory, derivatives, optimization problems, integrals, and differential equations
understand and be able to explain theses and proofs in mathematical analysis
have strengthened their logical argumentation and mathematical calculation skills
be able to read and understand other scientific texts on related topics

Knowledge and the ability to work with derivatives and integrals, essential tools for further studies of mathematical subjects, as well as for applications of mathematical techniques in Industrial Engineering.

syllabus_topics: The fundamental theorem of integral calculus
assessment_rules: The final exam consists of a preliminary written test which must be passed to access the theoretical oral exam. Assessment can also include a written and possibly oral examination.
bibliography: Marco Bramanti, Carlo D. Pagani, Sandro Salsa, Analisi Matematica vol. I e vol. II, Zanichelli Bologna, II edizione, 2025.
Sandro Salsa, Annamaria Squellati, Esercizi di Analisi Matematica vol. I e vol. II, Zanichelli Bologna, II edizione, 2025.
Marco Bramanti, Carlo D. Pagani, Sandro Salsa, Analisi Matematica vol. I e vol. II, Zanichelli Bologna 2017.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Industriale (Industrial Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
